This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual /Physical Mode).

2. Considering the urgency of the matter that the Petitioner apprehends his arrest and that the Courts are not functioning during the winter vacation, the matter is taken up directly without remanding the matter to the jurisdiction Sessions Court.
3.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State.
Perused the records.

4. This is an application under Section 438 of Cr.P.C filed by the Petitioner for anticipatory bail,
involving offence punishable under Sections 196, 420, 467, 468, 471 & 34 of IPC in G.R Case No.573 of 2021 of the Court of learned J.M.F.C., Pipili arising out of CID, CB P.S Case No.13 of 2021.
5.
Considering the facts of the case, this Court is not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the Petitioner.

However, on the submission of the learned counsel, the Petitioner is given liberty to surrender before the learned court in seisin over the matter in the aforesaid case in the first hour within 21 working days hence and move for bail.
On such event, the learned Magistrate shall consider his application for bail in the first hour strictly on the basis of the materials on record.
In case of rejection of the bail application, the Petitioner may move for bail before the higher forum in Prahallad Pradhan vs State Of Odisha .....
